_README: Risk guardrails for executor.py. NOTHING is executed unless `enabled` is true AND `mode` is 'paper' or 'live'. The shipped default (enabled=false, mode='propose') is propose-only: the executor vets signals against these limits and posts/logs PROPOSED orders, but never places a trade. Read README.md > 'Agentic execution (Robinhood MCP)' before flipping `enabled`.
_enabled_help: Master kill switch. false = propose-only no matter what `mode` says. The env var EXECUTOR_KILL=1 force-disables execution even when this is true.
_mode_help: 'propose' = vet + log proposals, never execute (safe default). 'paper' = simulate fills against a virtual cash balance, no real money. 'live' = place real orders via the Robinhood Agentic MCP (requires enabled=true AND robinhood_mcp wiring — see robinhood_mcp.py; access is still rolling out).
_account_value_help: Sizing basis in propose/paper mode. In live mode this is ignored and the real Agentic-account buying power is read from the MCP.
_allow_list_help: ONLY these tickers can be traded. Empty list = nothing is tradable (fail-closed). Keep this tight; it is the primary blast-radius limit. Seed from tickers you already research in StockNews.
_block_list_help: Hard deny, checked after allow_list. Use to pause a name without editing allow_list.
_allowed_sides_help: ['buy'] = accumulate-only (conservative default; the agent can never sell your position). Add 'sell' only once you trust the loop.
_min_signal_feeds_help: Only act on confluence signals corroborated by at least this many independent feeds (congress / insider / 8-K / 13F). 3 = all-feed overlap only — the highest-signal subset.
_max_notional_help: Hard ceiling on a single order's dollar size.
_max_pct_help: Single order may not exceed this fraction of account value. Order size = min(max_notional_per_order_usd, account_value * max_pct_account_per_order).
_max_orders_help: Cap on orders placed (or proposed-as-executable) per calendar day, counted from executor_state.json.
_max_total_deployed_help: Stop opening new positions once cumulative deployed capital (sum of filled notionals) reaches this fraction of account value.
_order_type_help: 'market' or 'limit'. Limit orders also read limit_offset_pct.
_limit_offset_help: For limit buys, place the limit this fraction below last price (e.g. 0.01 = 1% below). 0 = at last price.
_derivatives_help: Both stay false. The executor never constructs options or margin orders; these flags exist so a future change can't silently enable them.
